During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] '''attacked''' the Republic's [[Kabal Station]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Despite the surprise ambush, Imperial reinforcements were able to drive off the Republic forces and save the station.
